macro_cross_check: Computed over all 10 lines at source scale, 6 servings: 494 cal, 39.2 g protein, 29.6 g carbs per serving. Source published 569 / 30 / 50. Carbs match almost exactly (29.6 vs 30). Calories are -13%, acceptable. PROTEIN IS -21.6% AND THAT BREACHES THE 15% RULE, so I am flagging it rather than smoothing it: the gap is entirely the two substituted lines. The source's asterisked homemade 'high protein pesto' is a fortified sauce, while a jarred basil pesto carries 3 g protein per 62 g, and the source's pasta appears to be a very-high-protein brand (25 g per 2 oz class) rather than the 10 g per 2 oz Barilla Protein+ I priced and transcribed. The main protein is not the problem - 1.5 lb of breast for 6 servings is the source's own stated weight, giving 113 g raw per serving, below the catalog's 167 g average. NET EFFECT: at 39.2 g this recipe sits just UNDER this run's 40 g protein floor. It clears on calories (450-800). The band gate should rule on the assembled numbers; if it fails, the honest fix is a higher-protein pasta row or more chicken, not a re-weigh.
